follow-up time: Retrospectively from 8 years pre-first delivery to 8 years post-first delivery (2009-2018)
exposure: Strain of muscle, fascia, and tendon (SMFT)
strain of muscle, fascia, and tendon (SMFT)
outcome: Risk factors for LBP and PP
cohort: Women diagnosed with RAD and a history of labor and delivery between 2009 and 2018, identified from six hospitals within the Partners Healthcare System
finding: In postpartum women with RAD, depressive disorder (DD), strain of muscle, fascia, and tendon (SMFT), and pelvic pain (PP) were found to be risk factors contributing to the development of low back pain (LBP).
mod_finding: Women who underwent cesarean delivery demonstrated 4.5 times greater risk of RAD than those who had no cesarean delivery exposure.
